**Daily Devotional**

**April 26**

*10 And to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead, even Jesus, which delivered us from the wrath to come. (1 Thessalonians 1:10 KJV)*

The Thessalonians had turned from worshiping idols to worshiping the one and only true God, and Paul was praising them. They were anxiously awaiting the return of Jesus, as all Christians should. The return of Jesus will accomplish two things. One it will be the “blessed hope” that will redeem our purchased possessions (our bodies and souls), as we will get our incorruptible glorified bodies, and know all things (Titus 2:13; Hebrews 9:28). Two, it will bring on the judgment of all the unsaved people on the earth, both dead and alive, and the wrath of God will be poured out on them (2 Thessalonians 1:8; 1 Peter 4:17).

Our Savior Jesus is the only Savior in all the religions that was raised from the dead and is alive now in heaven. This makes our religion different from all the rest, as we are the only ones that have a Savior, and our Savior is alive and not still in the grave like all the rest. Not only was He seen by hundreds of believers after He rose from the dead (1 Corinthians 15:6), but I know He is alive today because I talk to Him every day. I hope you do the same by praising Him every day in thanksgiving and prayer. Praise God.

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
